agentId.description: Optional agent id on the service whose directives and knowledge-base items should layer into every prompt.

enabled.description: Set to false to register nothing and leave OpenClaw's built-in context engine in place.

serviceUrl.description: Base URL of the AiAS Memory service (the NEDB connector). Start it with run.sh from the aias-memory repo, or point this at any host running it. HTTPS is required for any non-loopback destination; plain HTTP is accepted only for loopback addresses.

workspaceId.description: Memory workspace: facts, discussion history and KB are namespaced under this id on the service.

description: Replaces OpenClaw's context assembly with the AiAS memory stack: extracted conversational facts (confidence- and PII-filtered), a NEDB-backed discussion window, and broadcast directives + knowledge base, all stored in NEDB, an embedded journal-backed database. Distilled from AiAS by INTERCHAINED LLC.
name: AiAS Memory for OpenClaw, powered by NEDB
